# Elzinga Creative Studio

> Professional photography, videography, and digital marketing agency based in Grand Rapids, Michigan. Serving West Michigan including Kent County, Ottawa County, and surrounding areas.

## About the Photographer

Kaden Elzinga is a Grand Rapids, Michigan-based photographer, videographer, and digital marketing strategist. He founded Elzinga Creative Studio as a full-service visual media LLC serving clients throughout West Michigan. Notable clients include the Grand Rapids Griffins (AHL hockey team), Biggby Coffee, and Mars Hill Church. He holds an FAA Part 107 Remote Pilot Certificate for commercial drone operations.

## Key Facts

- 24-hour turnaround on all real estate photography packages
- Service area: 19+ cities across Kent, Ottawa, and Allegan Counties
- Real estate packages start at $175 (Standard) through $525 (Signature)
- FAA Part 107 certified for commercial drone photography
- Commercial content retainers from $350/mo (Starter) to $650/mo (Growth)
- Available for travel beyond West Michigan for weddings and commercial projects
- Phone: (616) 258-4578

## About

Elzinga Creative Studio is a full-service visual media and digital marketing agency owned and operated by Kaden Elzinga. We specialize in real estate photography, portrait work, commercial content creation (Asset Packs), programmatic local SEO, and CRM reactivation for home service businesses. Our work has been used by real estate agents, local businesses, brands, sports organizations, and individuals throughout the greater Grand Rapids area.

## Services

### Real Estate Photography

Interior and exterior HDR photography for residential and commercial listings. Packages include standard daytime shoots, real twilight/blue hour shoots, 2D floor plans (CubiCasa), social media graphics, vertical cuts for Instagram/TikTok, and 60-second listing Reels. FAA Part 107 certified drone photography available. Designed to help realtors sell listings faster with professional, high-impact visuals. 24-hour turnaround on all packages.

**Packages:**
- Standard — $175: HDR interiors + exteriors, 25–35 images, MLS-ready, 24-hour delivery
- Showcase — $325: Everything in Standard + real twilight shoot + 2D floor plan + 3 social graphics + vertical cuts, 40–55 images
- Signature — $525: Everything in Showcase + golden hour exteriors + drone aerial shots + 60-second listing Reel, 55–70 images

### Commercial Content — Asset Packs

Value-based content packages designed for maximum social engagement and ROI for home service businesses, local brands, and restaurants. Optimized for Meta, TikTok, and Google Business Profile.

**Asset Pack Tiers:**
- Growth Pack: 10 High-Hook Vertical Reels (ASMR/action format) + 20 high-resolution brand stills. Optimized for Meta and TikTok ad campaigns.
- Velocity Pack: Weekly content delivery + CRM status syncing to Notion. Built for businesses that need a constant pipeline of fresh creative assets.

**Content Retainer Packages:**
- Starter — $350/mo: One monthly shoot, 15–20 finished images for social and GBP
- Growth — $650/mo: Two monthly shoots + short-form Reel, full content calendar

### CRM Reactivation (Zero-Cost Revenue)

ECS provides specialized CRM mining and reactivation for home service businesses including roofing, painting, and HVAC companies. We deploy AI-driven outreach playbooks to turn "Lost" or "Cold" leads into booked appointments — without additional ad spend. If you have a lead database you haven't touched in 6–18 months, we can extract revenue from it.

### Programmatic Local SEO & Answer Hubs

We build and deploy Programmatic Answer Hubs for local brands to dominate zero-click search results and AI engine citations across specific West Michigan geographies. Each hub is a cluster of geo-targeted, question-based pages designed to appear in Google AI Overviews, Perplexity, and ChatGPT search results for high-intent local queries.

Ideal for: roofing companies, painting contractors, solar installers, HVAC businesses, and local service area businesses across Kent, Ottawa, and Allegan Counties.

### Senior Portraits

High-quality senior portrait sessions for high school seniors throughout West Michigan. Natural, editorial, and lifestyle options available. Sessions available at Riverside Park, Downtown Grand Rapids, Millennium Park, local farms, and client-selected locations.

### Wedding Photography

Full-day wedding coverage and engagement sessions. Candid and portrait-style photography for couples in Grand Rapids and across Michigan.

### Sports Photography

Action and team photography for youth, high school, and professional sports organizations. Past clients include the Grand Rapids Griffins (AHL).

### Family Photography

Lifestyle and traditional family portrait sessions for all family sizes and compositions.

### Commercial & Brand Photography

Product photography, brand content, and marketing visuals for local businesses. Past clients include Biggby Coffee (Pop Kitchen LLC) and Mars Hill Church.

### Videography

Brand videos, event coverage, listing Reels, and promotional content for businesses and organizations throughout West Michigan.

### Digital Marketing & Meta Ads

Meta and Google Ads campaign creation and management. Full-service marketing support for small businesses looking to grow their digital presence.
